column1: # Hebrew (he) catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty                a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code
#            @id                  a command id (e.g. file.saveAs): wins over the English text for
#                                 that menu item, so one id can read differently from its twin
#            @plural              `source` is "one|other" (English forms); the translation lists the
#                                 language's forms separated by "|" (see `plural` in i18n.rs)
#            anything else        a disambiguating context passed to `tr_ctx`
#   escapes  \n  \t  \  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Modern Israeli Hebrew. Menu commands and buttons use verbal nouns (פתיחה, שמירה בשם…); prompts
# are impersonal ("יש לבחור…"). Product and technology names (PhotoCraft, PSD, RGB, CMYK, GPU …)
# and key names stay in Latin letters; the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept. Clean-room:
# written from the plain meaning of the English labels; no proprietary localisation resource was
# consulted. Plural rule: one|other. The chrome mirrors right to left. Drafted with an AI model;
# native-speaker review of the specialist terms is welcome.
